onChange.script:
# Tree's bidirectional writeback hands us BasicQualifiedValue
	# wrappers around the node's data dict + every nested field.
	# Deep-unwrap before passing Ids across module boundaries --
	# NQ param-binding rejects the wrappers with a ClassCastException.
	# View-scope script: self IS the view, so self.custom / self.rootContainer
	# are the valid handles here (not self.view.custom).
	prev = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(previousValue.value) if previousValue else None
	curr = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(currentValue.value) if currentValue else None
	prevId = prev.get("id") if prev else None
	currId = curr.get("id") if curr else None
	# Programmatic re-anchors (cancel revert, post-save, post-move, deprecate)
	# stamp guardIgnoreId so they never re-open the prompt. Self-healing: any
	# id other than the stamp clears it and gates normally, so a stamp whose
	# write never fired an onChange cannot swallow a real operator click.
	ignoreId = self.custom.guardIgnoreId
	if ignoreId is not None:
		self.custom.guardIgnoreId = None
		if currId == ignoreId:
			return
	if currId is None or currId == prevId:
		return
	self.rootContainer.requestLocationSwitch(currId, prev)

config.script:
sel = self.view.custom.selected or {}
	locId = sel.get("id")
	if locId is None:
		return
	result = BlueRidge.Location.Location.handleDeprecate(locId)
	if not result:
		return
	# Order matters: clear the old selection state before swapping items.
	# Tree component caches its selected path internally; if the new items
	# arrive first, that cached path no longer resolves -- Component Error.
	empty = BlueRidge.Location.Location.emptyMeta(None)
	self.view.custom.selected = None
	self.view.custom.selectedPath = None
	# ATOMIC.
	self.view.custom.state = {
		"selected":  dict(empty, attributes=[]),
		"editDraft": dict(empty, attributes=[]),
	}
	self.view.custom.mode = "view"
	self.view.custom.draftPath = None
	# Apply the refreshed tree (handleDeprecate re-anchors on the parent
	# of the deprecated row).
	self.view.custom.tree = result["tree"]
	# Now land selection on the parent so the operator keeps context. The row
	# being edited is gone, so there is nothing to prompt about -- stamp
	# guardIgnoreId so the selection guard stays out of the way.
	newParent = result.get("selected")
	if newParent and newParent.get("id") is not None:
		self.view.custom.guardIgnoreId = newParent.get("id")
		self.view.custom.selectedPath = result.get("selectedPath")
		self.view.custom.selected = newParent
		self.view.rootContainer.handleLocationChange(newParent.get("id"))

# Reset locationTypeDefinitionId when Type changes
	state = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.state) or {}
	draft = dict(state.get("editDraft") or {})
	draft["locationTypeDefinitionId"] = None
	draft["attributes"] = []
	self.view.custom.state = {
		"selected":  state.get("selected") or {},
		"editDraft": draft,
	}
	# Stash the selected Type Id in a transient view custom so DefinitionDropdown can read it.
	self.view.custom.draftTypeId = event.newValue if hasattr(event, "newValue") else self.props.value

customMethods.name: handleLocationChange
customMethods.script:
loc = BlueRidge.Location.Location.getOne(currId)
	if not loc:
		empty = BlueRidge.Location.Location.emptyMeta(None)
		# ATOMIC: baseline + draft land in ONE write. Two sequential writes
		# let the JSON-compare dirty binding re-evaluate mid-load, latch true,
		# and block every later switch behind a phantom prompt.
		self.view.custom.state = {
			"selected":  dict(empty, attributes=[]),
			"editDraft": dict(empty, attributes=[]),
		}
		self.view.custom.mode = "view"
		return
	meta = BlueRidge.Location.Location.metaFromLocation(loc)
	attrs = BlueRidge.Location.Location.buildAttributesForType(meta.get("locationTypeDefinitionId"), meta.get("id"))
	# ATOMIC -- see note above.
	self.view.custom.state = {
		"selected":  dict(meta, attributes=[dict(a) for a in (attrs or [])]),
		"editDraft": dict(meta, attributes=[dict(a) for a in (attrs or [])]),
	}
	self.view.custom.mode = "update"
	self.view.custom.draftPath = None
	self.view.custom.oldSelectedPath = self.view.custom.selectedPath

customMethods.name: touchEditDraft
customMethods.script:
# Re-assert view.custom.state as a WHOLE-OBJECT write after a meta field's
	# own bidirectional binding has already landed its value at
	# editDraft.meta.<field> (two levels below the property this method touches).
	# The JSON-compare dirty binding watches view.custom.state.editDraft as a
	# unit; mirrors the attribute-row fix (updateAttributeValue below) applied
	# to the meta fields, which were missed when that fix went in.
	state = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.state) or {}
	self.view.custom.state = {
		"selected":  state.get("selected") or {},
		"editDraft": state.get("editDraft") or {},
	}

customMethods.name: handleSave
customMethods.script:
draft = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.state.editDraft) or {}
	result = BlueRidge.Location.Location.handleSaveAll(draft, draft.get("attributes") or [])
	if not result:
		return False
	self.view.custom.tree = result["tree"]
	self.view.custom.guardIgnoreId = (result["selected"] or {}).get("id")
	self.view.custom.selectedPath = result["selectedPath"]
	self.view.custom.selected = result["selected"]
	savedMeta = result["editDraft"] or {}
	# ATOMIC: one write reseeds baseline + draft together.
	self.view.custom.state = {
		"selected":  dict(savedMeta),
		"editDraft": dict(savedMeta),
	}
	self.view.custom.mode = result["mode"]
	self.view.custom.draftPath = None
	self.view.custom.oldSelectedPath = result["selectedPath"]
	return True

customMethods.name: requestLocationSwitch
customMethods.script:
# Abandonment path 1/3 -- selecting a different node in the tree.
	# The tree has ALREADY written custom.selected / custom.selectedPath by
	# the time this runs, so a cancel has to put both back (cancelPendingNav).
	if not self.view.custom.dirty:
		self.handleLocationChange(currId)
		return
	self.view.custom.pendingNav = {
		"kind":         "select",
		"toId":         currId,
		"fromMode":     self.view.custom.mode,
		"fromSelected": prevSelected,
		"fromPath":     self.view.custom.oldSelectedPath,
	}
	self.openUnsavedPrompt("You have unsaved changes to this Location. Save before switching?")

customMethods.name: requestCreate
customMethods.script:
# Abandonment path 2/3 -- +Add Location swaps the draft for a blank one.
	sel = self.view.custom.selected
	if not sel or sel.get("id") is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Pick a parent", "Select a Location in the tree first.", "warning")
		return
	parentId = sel.get("id")
	parentLevel = sel.get("hierarchyLevel")
	if not self.view.custom.dirty:
		self.beginCreate(parentId, parentLevel)
		return
	self.view.custom.pendingNav = {"kind": "create", "parentId": parentId, "parentLevel": parentLevel}
	self.openUnsavedPrompt("You have unsaved changes to this Location. Save before adding a new one?")

customMethods.name: beginCreate
customMethods.script:
init = BlueRidge.Location.Location.beginCreate(parentId, parentLevel, self.view.custom.tree)
	if not init:
		return
	newMeta = init["meta"]
	self.view.custom.tree = init["tree"]
	self.view.custom.draftPath = init["draftPath"]
	self.view.custom.selectedPath = init["draftPath"]
	self.view.custom.oldSelectedPath = init["draftPath"]
	# id is None here, and the selection guard early-returns on a null id,
	# so this write needs no guardIgnoreId stamp.
	self.view.custom.selected = {"id": None, "name": "(new Location)", "hierarchyLevel": parentLevel}
	# ATOMIC, and baseline == draft: a brand-new blank draft starts CLEAN and
	# only goes dirty once the operator actually types something.
	self.view.custom.state = {
		"selected":  dict(newMeta, attributes=[]),
		"editDraft": dict(newMeta, attributes=[]),
	}
	self.view.custom.mode = "create"

customMethods.name: requestMove
applyMove
customMethods.script:
sel = self.view.custom.selected
	if not sel or sel.get("id") is None:
		return
	if direction == "up":
		result = BlueRidge.Location.Location.handleMoveUp(sel)
	else:
		result = BlueRidge.Location.Location.handleMoveDown(sel)
	if not result:
		return
	movedId = (result["selected"] or {}).get("id")
	self.view.custom.tree = result["tree"]
	self.view.custom.guardIgnoreId = movedId
	self.view.custom.selectedPath = result["selectedPath"]
	self.view.custom.selected = result["selected"]
	# Re-baseline: the proc changed SortOrder underneath the draft.
	self.handleLocationChange(movedId)

customMethods.name: handleCancel
customMethods.script:
if self.view.custom.mode == "create":
		# Drop the synthetic draft node and rebuild the tree from the DB.
		empty = BlueRidge.Location.Location.emptyMeta(None)
		self.view.custom.tree = BlueRidge.Location.Tree.buildTree(1, 2, "mpp/factory")
		self.view.custom.draftPath = None
		self.view.custom.guardIgnoreId = None
		self.view.custom.selected = None
		self.view.custom.selectedPath = "0"
		self.view.custom.oldSelectedPath = "0"
		# ATOMIC.
		self.view.custom.state = {
			"selected":  dict(empty, attributes=[]),
			"editDraft": dict(empty, attributes=[]),
		}
		self.view.custom.mode = "view"
		return
	sel = self.view.custom.selected
	if sel and sel.get("id") is not None:
		self.handleLocationChange(sel.get("id"))

customMethods.name: openUnsavedPrompt
customMethods.script:
# showCloseIcon / overlayDismiss stay off on purpose: a dismissal that
	# skips the reply message would strand pendingNav with the tree already
	# moved off the node the draft belongs to.
	system.perspective.openPopup(
		id="mpp-confirm-unsaved",
		view="BlueRidge/Components/Popups/ConfirmUnsaved",
		modal=True,
		showCloseIcon=False,
		overlayDismiss=False,
		params={
			"title":   "Unsaved Changes",
			"message": message,
		},
	)

customMethods.name: applyPendingNav
customMethods.script:
pending = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.pendingNav) or {}
	kind = pending.get("kind")
	self.view.custom.pendingNav = None
	if kind == "select":
		toId = pending.get("toId")
		# A create draft injects a synthetic node, so every path below it has
		# shifted; a create-save rebuilt the tree around the NEW row. Either
		# way, re-anchor on the target before loading it.
		if pending.get("fromMode") == "create" or self.view.custom.draftPath is not None:
			items = BlueRidge.Location.Tree.buildTree(1, 2, "mpp/factory")
			BlueRidge.Location.Tree.expandToTarget(items, toId)
			newPath = BlueRidge.Location.Tree.findPathById(items, toId)
			self.view.custom.tree = items
			self.view.custom.draftPath = None
			self.view.custom.guardIgnoreId = toId
			self.view.custom.selectedPath = newPath
			self.view.custom.selected = BlueRidge.Location.Tree.getNodeData(items, newPath)
		self.handleLocationChange(toId)
	elif kind == "create":
		self.beginCreate(pending.get("parentId"), pending.get("parentLevel"))
	elif kind == "move":
		self.applyMove(pending.get("direction"))

customMethods.name: cancelPendingNav

messageHandlers.script:
idx = payload.get("index") if payload else None
	val = payload.get("value") if payload else None
	if idx is None:
		return
	state = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.state) or {}
	draft = dict(state.get("editDraft") or {})
	attrs = list(draft.get("attributes") or [])
	if idx < 0 or idx >= len(attrs):
		return
	row = dict(attrs[idx])
	row["value"] = val if val is not None else ""
	attrs[idx] = row
	draft["attributes"] = attrs
	# Whole-state write: the baseline half is carried through untouched so the
	# JSON-compare dirty binding stays honest.
	self.view.custom.state = {
		"selected":  state.get("selected") or {},
		"editDraft": draft,
	}

# pendingNav doubles as the "is this OUR prompt?" test. The LocationTypeEditor
	# popup opens the same ConfirmUnsaved view and replies on the same page-scoped
	# message; without this guard its Save reply would save a Location behind the
	# modal. pendingNav is only ever set while our own modal is up, so it cannot
	# be staged when somebody else's reply arrives.
	pending = self.view.custom.pendingNav
	if not pending:
		return
	action = payload.get("action") if payload else None
	if action == "save":
		if not self.handleSave():
			# Rejected -- notifyResult already toasted. Keep the draft and put
			# the tree back where it was.
			self.cancelPendingNav()
			return
	elif action == "discard":
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Discarded", "Changes discarded.", "info")
	else:
		self.cancelPendingNav()
		return
	self.applyPendingNav()
